name: @wasmos/abi
description: Generated WASI / wasmos_kernel ABI bindings. The textual contents of generated/ (kernel.js + .d.ts) are jco output produced by `npm run binder gen` from the kernel component and checked into the repository; the .core*.wasm payloads are build artifacts loaded at runtime by the kernel worker via /packages/abi/generated/kernel.js. This manifest exists so the directory is a well-formed npm workspace member (root workspaces: packages/*).
